title: Suspicious Skin Lesion Classification
description: Classify a skin image as suspicious, benign, or normal skin.
long_description: This project allows you to train a YOLO-based model to identify suspicious skin lesions (melanoma, basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and actinic keratosis), benign lesions (nevus and seborrheic keratosis), and normal skin with no lesion in an image/video. This model is suitable for first screening on an MCU board such as PSOC™ Edge and for wearable skin-check applications.
